senses.gloss:
तुप् तुप् or तुफ् or तुम्प् or तुम्फ्, cl. 1.
6. P. तोपति, तुपति, तोफति, तुफति,
तुम्पति, तुम्फति, &c., (in the last two the form
in cl. 1. will only differ from that in cl. 6. by the
accent), to injure, hurt, wound; kill; तुम्प्, cl. 10.
P. तुम्पयति, &c., a various reading for तुम्ब्, q. v.;
[cf. Gr. τύπ-τ-ω, τύπο-ς, τυπή, τύμ-μα, τυπά(δ)ς,
τύμπ-ανο-ν; Lat. stupeo; Old Germ. stumpf,
stumb-alon, stumph; Old Island. stūf-r.]

तूपर तूपर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. hornless,
(often applied to a goat, and sometimes used alone
to denote ‘a hornless goat.’)
